articles.title: Forget Nvidia: The next big AI trade could be crypto and blockchain
articles.snippet: Franklin Templeton’s Sandy Kaul and Circle CEO Jeremy Allaire argue that as autonomous AI agents start spending money on their own, blockchain networks will power the next big AI trade.

articles.title: Bitcoin retreats from one-month high as oil tops $85, inflation concerns resurface
articles.snippet: BTC retreated from a one-month high as WTI crude topped $85 for the first time since June, reigniting inflation concerns and pushing investors toward gold, silver and the safety of bitcoin over altcoins.

articles.title: Crypto lobby group Digital Chamber sues Illinois to block digital asset tax
articles.snippet: Illinois enacted a 0.2% tax on all crypto transactions last month, with the tax taking effect next year.

articles.title: Movement Labs files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy months after token scandal
articles.snippet: The filing comes after months of upheaval that included a controversial market-making agreement, an internal investigation into its MOVE token launch and a Binance ban tied to its market maker.

articles.title: The digital euro: Surveillance money, or a better alternative to cash?
articles.snippet: Proponents of the digital euro say its a better alternative to cash that’s fully backed by the ECB. But critics argue it could provide the EU with too much power over its citizens.
